tool_input.command: cat data/contract.md; echo "=====EVENTS====="; head -30 data/events.csv; echo "=====WC====="; wc -l data/events.csv
hops --help 2>&1 | head -60
hops fg --help 2>&1
hops fg create --help 2>&1; echo "=====INSERT====="; hops fg insert --help 2>&1
tool_input.description: Show fg create and insert help

tool_input.command: hops sql --help 2>&1; echo "=====DERIVE====="; hops fg derive --help 2>&1; echo "=====PREVIEW====="; hops fg preview --help 2>&1
hops context --json 2>&1 | head -40

cd "$(pwd)" && hops fg create events_staging_5a6eae \
  --version 1 \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --event-time event_time \
  --features "row_id:string,account_id:string,event_time:bigint,amount:double,category:string" \
  --description "Staging: raw events for contract validation" \
  --json 2>&1 | tail -20
cd "$(pwd)" && hops fg insert events_staging_5a6eae --version 1 --file data/events.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -25
tool_input.description: Insert all rows into staging FG

tool_input.command: cd "$(pwd)" && hops sql "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM events_staging_5a6eae_1" --json 2>&1 | tail -15
cd "$(pwd)" && hops sql --no-verify "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM events_staging_5a6eae_1" --json 2>&1 | tail -15
cd "$(pwd)" && hops trino --help 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "=====TABLES====="; hops trino tables --no-verify --json 2>&1 | tail -30
cd "$(pwd)" && hops trino tables iceberg.mlpab446f73 --no-verify --json 2>&1 | tail -20
cd "$(pwd)" && hops trino catalogs --no-verify --json 2>&1 | tail -10; echo "=====SCHEMAS====="; hops trino schemas iceberg --no-verify --json 2>&1 | tail -10
cd "$(pwd)" && hops trino tables iceberg.mlpab446f73_featurestore --no-verify --json 2>&1 | tail -15

cd "$(pwd)" && hops sql --no-verify --schema mlpab446f73_featurestore --limit 0 --json \
"SELECT row_id, amount, category,
   (amount IS NULL) AS amt_null,
   (amount < 0 OR amount > 10000) AS amt_range,
   (category NOT IN ('grocery','travel','salary','rent','other')) AS bad_cat
 FROM events_staging_5a6eae_1
 WHERE amount IS NULL OR amount < 0 OR amount > 10000
    OR category NOT IN ('grocery','travel','salary','rent','other')
 ORDER BY row_id" 2>&1 | tail -80
cd "$(pwd)" && hops trino catalogs --no-verify --json 2>&1 | grep -i catalog

cd "$(pwd)" && hops sql --no-verify --catalog hudi --schema mlpab446f73_featurestore --limit 0 --json \
"SELECT row_id FROM events_staging_5a6eae_1
 WHERE amount IS NULL OR amount < 0 OR amount > 10000
    OR category NOT IN ('grocery','travel','salary','rent','other')
 ORDER BY row_id" 2>&1 | grep -E '"row_id"|R0|Error|error|Trino' | head -80
tool_input.description: Query rejected rows from hudi catalog

tool_input.command:
cd "$(pwd)" && hops sql --no-verify --catalog hive --schema mlpab446f73_featurestore --limit 0 --json \
"SELECT row_id FROM events_staging_5a6eae_1
 WHERE amount IS NULL OR amount < 0 OR amount > 10000
    OR category NOT IN ('grocery','travel','salary','rent','other')
 ORDER BY row_id" 2>&1 | grep -E '"row_id"|R0[0-9]|Error|TrinoUser|TrinoExternal|message=' | head -90
tool_input.description: Query rejected rows from hive catalog

tool_input.command:
cd "$(pwd)" && hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab446f73_featurestore --limit 0 --json \
"SELECT row_id FROM events_staging_5a6eae_1
 WHERE amount IS NULL OR amount < 0 OR amount > 10000
    OR category NOT IN ('grocery','travel','salary','rent','other')
 ORDER BY row_id" 2>&1 | grep -oE 'R0[0-9]{4}' | sort -u > .tmp_rejected.txt; wc -l < .tmp_rejected.txt; echo "---sample---"; head .tmp_rejected.txt
tool_input.description: Query rejected rows from delta catalog

tool_input.command:
cd "$(pwd)" && hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab446f73_featurestore --json \
"SELECT
   count(*) AS total,
   count_if(amount IS NULL) AS amt_null,
   count_if(amount IS NOT NULL AND (amount < 0 OR amount > 10000)) AS amt_range,
   count_if(category NOT IN ('grocery','travel','salary','rent','other')) AS bad_cat,
   count_if(amount IS NOT NULL AND amount >= 0 AND amount <= 10000 AND category IN ('grocery','travel','salary','rent','other')) AS valid
 FROM events_staging_5a6eae_1" 2>&1 | grep -A2 -iE 'total|amt_null|amt_range|bad_cat|valid' | head -40

cd "$(pwd)" && mkdir -p submission .tmp && \
grep -vF -f .tmp_rejected.txt data/events.csv > .tmp/valid_events.csv && \
echo "valid file lines (incl header): $(wc -l < .tmp/valid_events.csv)" && \
echo "header: $(head -1 .tmp/valid_events.csv)" && \
echo "rejected count: $(wc -l < .tmp_rejected.txt)"
tool_input.description: Build valid-rows CSV excluding rejected ids

tool_input.command:
cd "$(pwd)" && hops fg create events5a6eae \
  --version 1 \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --event-time event_time \
  --online \
  --features "row_id:string,account_id:string,event_time:bigint,amount:double,category:string" \
  --description "Validated events satisfying data contract; online-enabled" \
  --json 2>&1 | grep -E '"name"|"version"|"online_enabled"|"id"|Error|Traceback' | head
cd "$(pwd)" && hops fg insert events5a6eae --version 1 --file .tmp/valid_events.csv --json 2>&1 | grep -E '"rows"|"feature_group"|Error|Traceback|Exception' | head
tool_input.description: Insert valid rows into target FG

tool_input.command: cd "$(pwd)" && cat .tmp_rejected.txt | tr '\n' ' '
cd "$(pwd)" && echo "=== ONLINE READ ===" && hops fg preview events5a6eae --version 1 --online --n 5 --json 2>&1 | grep -E '"row_id"|"amount"|"category"|Error|Traceback|Exception|empty' | head -20

cd "$(pwd)" && hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab446f73_featurestore --json \
"SELECT count(*) AS n,
   count_if(amount IS NULL OR amount<0 OR amount>10000 OR category NOT IN ('grocery','travel','salary','rent','other')) AS violations
 FROM events5a6eae_1" 2>&1 | grep -E '"n"|"violations"' | head
tool_input.description: Verify target FG count and zero violations
